Create a 20-second high-end live-action dark-fantasy combat sequence in the Anger realm from the user’s Voices in the Void: Hollow Heart project. This is a dedicated specialist fight for the giant Hand-Crown Centipede Stalker. The scene must feel epic as fuck, brutal, eventful, physically grounded, and visually unforgettable. It must feel like the Hero is trying to survive a horrifying large-scale predator while still forcing his way deeper through the Anger realm.

This should be one relentless cinematic survival sequence: the Hero runs, gets pursued, gets hit, gets knocked down, adapts, uses the environment intelligently, injures the creature, and breaks past it. He is not effortlessly stronger than it. He survives because he refuses to stop and thinks under pressure.

REFERENCE / DESIGN RULE:
Use the provided Hand-Crown Centipede reference strictly as a DESIGN / ANATOMY / SILHOUETTE blueprint, not as a style reference. Preserve the recognizable identity: the giant grotesque hand-headed centipede body, weaponized finger-crown, eye and mouth in the hand-head region, long many-limbed body, fused human-remnant grotesquery, and disturbing scale. Do not genericize it into a normal insect. Do not simplify it. Do not redesign it away from the approved concept.

Highest-end Hollywood live-action dark-fantasy realism. ARRI Alexa 65 cinematic fidelity. Ultra-detailed practical material realism. Expensive production value. Grounded body physics. Natural motion blur. Rich atmospheric depth. Subtle film grain. Soft lens diffusion. No game-engine look. No cheap CGI. No painterly concept-art finish. No anime movement. No rubbery creature surfaces.

Use the approved Hollow Heart Hero exactly.

Minimal facial hair.

Dirty, battle-worn clothing.
No cape.
No jeans.
No belt.
One fingerless glove.
Opposite hand wrapped.
Scarred exposed arm.
He carries the approved HEAVY SWORD.

The heavy sword must feel truly heavy and require planted footwork, shoulder engagement, body torque, and two hands for all major attacks. No effortless lightweight fantasy swinging.

ABSOLUTE HOLLOW HEART LOCK:
The Hero’s chest cavity must remain exactly correct at all times: a large irregular three-dimensional front-to-back hole through the chest with true depth and parallax, torn organic fleshy rim, and clothing torn around the opening. It must never flatten, never fill in, never shrink, never move, never be covered, never become a black decal, and never disappear during action.

The Hero is NEVER passive.
He is never casually standing there.
He is never relaxed.
He is battle-ready the entire time: breathing hard, knees active, shoulders engaged, sword ready, eyes tracking threats, body coiled to react. Even when he is running, falling, or recovering from impact, he should look locked into survival. He is exhausted, injured, bloodied, furious, and determined, but he never gives up and never mentally checks out.

scorched earth,

This creature is a major escalation enemy and must feel terrifyingly large and distinct.

Approximate scale:
about 22 feet long overall,
low predatory crawl height around 4.5 feet,

The hand-head has a monstrous eye and a grotesque toothed mouth integrated into the palm region.
Five finger-crown structures rise from the hand-head and each finger is weaponized, dangerous, and physically threatening.
The finger structures should read like grotesque bladed / hooked / spiked attack limbs, not soft decorative appendages.

The rest of the creature is a long horrifying centipede-like body made of many disgusting segments.

rear its front third upward,

its bizarre anatomy,
its hand-head weapon identity,

getting intercepted,

slide through ash and corpses,

The Hero hits the ground violently.

Before he can fully recover, the creature is already advancing — it does NOT wait for him to stand back up.

the five weaponized fingers,
then enough of the long many-limbed body to understand the scale and disturbing segmented movement.

BLOOD ON CONTACT immediately.

0:09 - 0:12
The Hero scrambles up and realizes he cannot beat this thing head-on in open space.

The Hero instantly capitalizes and attacks before it fully recovers.
He closes in with real commitment and delivers savage two-handed cuts into vulnerable limb clusters / attacking finger structures / lower front body areas.
Immediate blood.

0:15 - 0:17

It should still feel dangerous even after the trap.
It may violently fling the Hero into a corpse pile, clip him with another weaponized finger, or slam the ground beside him so hard it blasts ash and debris into the air.

0:17 - 0:20

He avoids another attack line, steps inside at the right angle, and delivers one brutal decisive two-handed cut into a key junction — for example the base of one weaponized finger, part of the hand-head structure, or another vulnerable front-limb connection.
Immediate blood.
This does NOT need to fully kill the monster.
Instead, it badly injures / cripples / disrupts it long enough for the Hero to break through the line.
End with the Hero stumbling / running deeper into the Anger realm, sword bloodied, body covered in ash and blood, still battle-ready and refusing to stop, while behind him the wounded Hand-Crown Centipede tears itself free from the tree and thrashes furiously in the burning corpse field.

Use motivated expensive camera movement, not random shaky nonsense.

parallax movement,

No effortless giant-sword nonsense.
The creature must feel fast, massive, and dangerous.
Its attacks should have violent momentum and mass.

TEXTURE / MATERIAL FIDELITY:
The Anger realm must feel filthy, scorched, corpse-littered, and physically real.

Deliver a brutal, epic, trailer-worthy 20-second Anger-realm specialist fight where the approved Hollow Heart Hero is hunted by the giant Hand-Crown Centipede Stalker, gets hurt, uses the environment intelligently, wounds the creature in savage close-range exchanges, and forces his way past it without giving up. TITLE: HOLLOW HEART — THE LIVING TREE REVEAL

DURATION: 20 SECONDS
ASPECT RATIO: 9:16
STYLE: ultra-photorealistic cinematic dark fantasy, the most expensive movie ever made
QUALITY: hyper-detailed, prestige live-action realism, maximum fidelity
CAMERA RULE: camera is NEVER static — every shot has motivated movement, slight orbit, slow push, glide, parallax drift, tilt, or controlled handheld creep
EDITING RULE: do NOT linger too long on any one composition; this must generate multiple usable shots within the 20 seconds
MOOD: eerie, sacred, cursed, strange, memorable, hypnotic, ominous, dreamlike, psychologically disturbing
AUDIO: no music, only premium diegetic sound design — distant wind, subtle wood creaks, bark strain, faint root groans, soft branch movement, tiny bird claws scraping bark, subtle breath-like ambience, faint insect-like clicking, distant atmospheric low rumble

USE ONLY THESE REFERENCES:
1. approved main living tree reference
2. approved spiral/twirled branch reference
3. approved eye-branch reference
4. approved crescent moon bird reference

ABSOLUTE HARD LOCKS:

- The tree must remain the same approved living cursed tree design.
- Its giant face must remain recognizable and integrated into the trunk.
- The spiral / twirled branch must clearly appear and read as an important silhouette.
- Another branch with embedded eye-like growths must appear clearly in at least one shot.
- The tree must feel subtly alive, not cartoonish: bark flexing, tiny trunk strain, branches slightly shifting, trunk subtly leaning or turning as if listening.
- The tree may slowly tilt or lean to one side in a strange unnatural way.
- The crescent moon birds are small crow-like creatures perched on the spiral branch.
- Their bodies are black feathered crow-like bodies.
- Their heads are pale crescent-moon faces, eerie and expressive, with dark eyes.
- There should be MULTIPLE birds perched on the spiral branch, preferably 3–4 visible across the sequence.
- The birds must make creepy tiny head turns, subtle posture changes, and unsettling pauses.
- Do NOT make them cute, comedic, or overly animated.
- The world must feel haunted and surreal.
- Background depth should use soft bokeh blur, not flat painting-like imagery.
- Keep the same overall biome identity and coloration: dark cursed land, moody sky, crimson atmosphere in the distance, premium realistic environmental depth.
- If distant branches or silhouettes appear, they should be twisted, contorted, strange, and otherworldly.

CINEMATIC APPROACH:
This is a modular establishing sequence made of multiple shots. Every shot must feel expensive, intentional, and editorially useful. Prioritize iconic compositions, macro detail, atmospheric parallax, and visual rhythm. Every 2–4 seconds should yield a fresh usable visual.

TIMESTAMPED STRUCTURE:

0:00 - 0:03
Open on a premium low-angle extremely close up right under the tree cinematic reveal of the massive living tree in the cursed landscape. The camera slowly pushes in and slightly tilts upward, giving the tree scale and mythic presence. The spiral branch is already visible in silhouette. The tree’s trunk subtly strains and leans a little to one side, as if waking or listening. Very slight parallax in foreground debris or roots. The sky is heavy and moody, with subtle crimson in the far atmosphere.

0:03 - 0:06
Cut to a medium-close shot gliding across the tree’s face. The camera slowly orbits across one side of the trunk, revealing the facial structure embedded in bark. Its eyes make subtle unsettling shifts — not exaggerated, just enough to feel alive. Tiny movements in the bark and creases make the face feel organic. The branch structure above and beside the face moves almost imperceptibly in the wind.

0:06 - 0:09
Cut to a macro / close-up of the spiral branch with multiple crescent moon birds perched along it. The camera creeps laterally with shallow depth of field and beautiful parallax. One bird slowly turns its crescent face toward camera. Another tilts its head the opposite direction. Another remains frozen and eerie. Their claws grip the bark. Feathers subtly ruffle. Their movement is minimal but deeply strange.

0:09 - 0:12
Cut to a close-up of the eye-branch. The camera slides past the branch at a diagonal angle, revealing embedded eye-like forms within the twisted wood. Some of the eyes subtly shift or focus. The branch itself gives a tiny organic flex. Use razor-sharp foreground detail with creamy bokeh background. This should feel invasive and disturbing.

0:12 - 0:15
Cut to a cool high-angle or slightly top-down drifting shot looking down across the spiral branch and the perched birds, then letting the tree’s face enter frame below or beyond it. One of the birds gives a quick eerie head snap. Another subtly hops or adjusts its feet. The camera glides with elegant motion so the composition feels like a prestige horror fantasy film.

0:15 - 0:17.5
Cut to a stronger, more iconic shot of the tree itself — either a lower wide angle or medium heroic angle where the face, spiral branch, and strange silhouette all read together. The trunk subtly leans forward. One branch curls or shifts slightly as if the tree is observing the viewer. The eyes in the face make another tiny shift. This should feel like the world’s central cursed monument.

0:17.5 - 0:20
Final beauty shot: a close or medium-close shot on the crescent moon birds perched together on the spiral branch, with the tree’s face or ominous silhouette softly present behind them in bokeh depth. The camera performs a slow creeping push or tiny orbit. The birds each behave a little differently: one turns its head toward camera, one looks away into the distance, one blinks or gives a tiny unnatural pause, one subtly raises its posture. End on a haunting frame that feels memorable and editorially powerful.

IMPORTANT NEGATIVES:
- no static camera
- no cartoon animation
- no goofy bird behavior
- no cute expressions
- no random extra creatures
- no hero
- no woman
- no moon enemy
- no washed-out fog that destroys the color palette
- no flat painterly background
- no low-detail branches
- no duplicate-looking birds behaving in exactly the same way
- no dead air
- no long empty holds
- no generic fantasy tree

GOAL:
Generate a visually unforgettable establishing sequence of the cursed living tree and its crescent moon birds, with multiple premium shots inside 20 seconds, all highly usable for editing, strange as hell, hyper-detailed, creepy, elegant, and expensive-looking.

prompt:
TITLE: HOLLOW HEART — THE GUIDE DISAPPEARS INTO THE TREE

DURATION: 20 SECONDS
ASPECT: 9:16 VERTICAL
QUALITY: 8K IMAX / LARGE-FORMAT PHOTOREALISTIC LIVE ACTION
STYLE: PRESTIGE PSYCHOLOGICAL DARK FANTASY
MUSIC: NONE
SOUND: CLEAN DIEGETIC AUDIO ONLY

THIS IS A DIRECT CONTINUATION OF THE HERO'S FIRST ENCOUNTER WITH THE FEMALE CRESCENT GUIDE.

THIS GENERATION MUST TELL ONE VERY CLEAR STORY:

THE HERO DISCOVERS THE GUIDE AT THE TRAUMA TREE ENTRANCE.

SHE SAYS:

“This way.”

SHE THEN IMMEDIATELY TURNS AND PHYSICALLY WALKS INTO THE TREE.

SHE COMPLETELY DISAPPEARS FROM VIEW.

ONLY AFTER SHE IS GONE DOES THE HERO DECIDE TO FOLLOW.

THE HERO APPROACHES THE NOW-EMPTY ENTRANCE.

THE CRIMSON LIGHT BECOMES OVERWHELMING.

HE SHIELDS HIS EYES.

CUT BEFORE WE SEE HIM FULLY ENTER.

======================================================================
CRITICAL TIMING RULE — FEMALE MUST DISAPPEAR
======================================================================

THE FEMALE GUIDE MUST BE COMPLETELY GONE BY APPROXIMATELY 0:10.

AFTER 0:10:

SHE MUST NEVER APPEAR AGAIN.

NO FULL BODY.

NO FACE.

NO SILHOUETTE.

NO WOMAN WAITING IN THE DOORWAY.

NO WOMAN VISIBLE DEEP INSIDE THE TREE.

NO REAPPEARANCE WHEN HERO REACHES THE ENTRANCE.

NO TELEPORTING BACK INTO FRAME.

NO DUPLICATE FEMALE ENTITY.

AFTER SHE ENTERS THE TREE, THE ENTRANCE IS EMPTY.

The only OPTIONAL remaining trace of her is:

ONE butterfly briefly flying deeper into the crimson passage.

Nothing else.

======================================================================
ABSOLUTE EXTERIOR COLOR LOCK
======================================================================

THE PROVIDED TRAUMA TREE / LAND REFERENCE CONTROLS THE ENTIRE EXTERIOR WORLD.

DO NOT RECOLOR THE BIOME.

PRESERVE EXACTLY:

— charcoal-black / dark brown wet terrain
— subtle deep burgundy undertones
— black roots
— dead dirty-gray vegetation
— distant restrained crimson atmospheric accents
— smoky charcoal / blue-black sky
— dark desaturated foreground
— wet reflective patches where appropriate

THE EXTERIOR MUST NOT BECOME:

bright red,
orange,
neutral gray,
blue-gray,
green,
washed out,
or monochromatic.

NO AUTOMATIC COLOR-GRADE CHANGE BETWEEN SHOTS.

======================================================================
CRIMSON TREE INTERIOR — LOCALIZED ONLY
======================================================================

THE TREE INTERIOR HAS A DEEP CRIMSON-RED GLOW.

THIS RED LIGHT EXISTS PRIMARILY INSIDE THE TREE.

It does NOT recolor the entire exterior landscape.

Inside the doorway:

— deep crimson atmospheric illumination
— black-red organic walls
— subtle wet surface reflections
— extremely fine red particulate
— localized transparent crimson vapor
— deep mysterious spatial recession
— irregular dark internal structures

THE DOORWAY MUST FEEL DEEP.

NOT a flat red wall.

NOT a red studio backdrop.

NOT a curtain.

NOT a solid red background.

When the female is shown in close-up, the background behind her must remain:

THE REAL TREE INTERIOR,
softly bokeh-blurred,
with organic dark shapes,
depth,
crimson light,
particles,
and subtle red-black vapor.

======================================================================
TRAUMA TREE — ABSOLUTE LOCK
======================================================================

USE THE EXACT APPROVED TRAUMA TREE.

PRESERVE:

— colossal ancient scale
— sorrowful humanoid bark face
— grieving expression
— black tear streaks
— physically tilted sideways AND slightly forward
— giant spiral branch
— established asymmetrical structure
— embedded eyes where approved
— decayed bark
— massive root system
— mouth functioning as gateway

NO GENERIC SCREAMING TREE.

NO REDESIGNED TREE FACE.

NO SECOND TREE.

NO DUPLICATE ENTRANCE.

NO AGGRESSIVE TREE ATTACK.

The tree may produce a deep resonant wooden GROAN / CREAK.

======================================================================
HERO — ABSOLUTE CONTINUITY LOCK
======================================================================

MATCH THE APPROVED HERO EXACTLY:

— exact face
— exact tan / olive-tan skin
— exact silver-gray human eyes
— exact medium-long messy dark hair
— exact scar
— light stubble
— exact tattered clothing
— exact body proportions

NO RANDOM EXTRA FABRIC ON HIS EXPOSED SCARRED ARM.

NO NEW BANDAGE.
NO LOOSE CLOTH.
NO EXTRA SLEEVE.
NO FABRIC FLAPPING FROM THAT ARM.

======================================================================
HERO HOLLOW HEART — TRUE MISSING GEOMETRY
======================================================================

THIS IS AN EXTREMELY IMPORTANT CONTINUITY REQUIREMENT.

THE HERO'S UPPER-CHEST HOLLOW HEART IS A LITERAL FRONT-TO-BACK ABSENCE OF HIS TORSO.

THE CAMERA CAN SEE COMPLETELY THROUGH HIS BODY.

THERE IS NOTHING IN THE CENTER.

NO:

heart,
lung,
rib,
sternum,
muscle,
flesh bridge,
internal anatomy,
dark flesh,
body part,
organ,
bone,
membrane,
black object.

ONLY THE OUTER RIM OF THE CAVITY CONTAINS WEATHERED FLESH / CLOTHING DAMAGE.

THE ENTIRE CENTER IS EMPTY SPACE.

THE ACTUAL PHYSICAL BACKGROUND BEHIND THE HERO MUST BE VISIBLE THROUGH THE OPENING.

IF THE FIELD IS BEHIND HIM:
THE FIELD IS VISIBLE THROUGH HIS CHEST.

IF THE TREE IS BEHIND HIM:
THE TREE IS VISIBLE THROUGH HIS CHEST.

IF THE RED DOORWAY IS BEHIND HIM:
THE RED DOORWAY IS VISIBLE THROUGH HIS CHEST.

WHEN THE CAMERA MOVES:

THE BACKGROUND MUST SHIFT WITH TRUE PARALLAX THROUGH THE HOLE.

DO NOT FILL THE CAVITY WITH ANY BODY MATERIAL.

======================================================================
HERO PERFORMANCE — IMPORTANT
======================================================================

The hero has JUST witnessed terrifying events elsewhere in the field.

He is still shaken.

His acting must communicate:

fear,
confusion,
urgency,
hesitation,
survival instinct.

He does NOT calmly stroll after her.

He does NOT look relaxed.

He does NOT confidently march toward the tree.

His emotional progression:

WHAT THE HELL WAS THAT?
→ WHAT IS SHE?
→ SHE'S LEAVING
→ SHIT, THAT MAY BE MY ONLY WAY OUT
→ I DON'T WANT TO GO IN THERE
→ FUCK IT, GO.

Physical behavior:

uneven breathing,
eyes searching,
brief glance back over shoulder,
slight stumble,
uncertain first step,
then faster commitment.

Grounded.
Human.
No melodrama.

======================================================================
FEMALE GUIDE — ABSOLUTE DESIGN LOCK
======================================================================

MATCH THE APPROVED FEMALE ENTITY EXACTLY.

PRESERVE:

— exact face
— exact crescent integrated into one side of head/face
— exact long dark braid
— dark blue-black body coloration
— pale cracked contrasting regions
— ruined elegant dark dress
— upper-chest Hollow Heart
— BOTH ARMS AT ALL TIMES
— botanical / vine / rose arm
— butterflies around botanical arm

ABSOLUTE ARM LOCK:

SHE MUST HAVE BOTH ARMS THROUGHOUT EVERY FRAME SHE IS VISIBLE.

DO NOT REMOVE AN ARM.

DO NOT MERGE ARMS.

DO NOT TURN AN ARM INTO ONLY VINES.

DO NOT HIDE AN ARM BEHIND THE TORSO FOR THE ENTIRE SHOT.

DO NOT GENERATE ONE-ARMED ANATOMY.

Her botanical arm remains an ARM underneath / integrated with living botanical structures.

======================================================================
BOTANICAL ARM — ALWAYS ALIVE
======================================================================

WHENEVER HER BOTANICAL ARM IS VISIBLE:

— vines slowly curl
— small tendrils adjust
— thorny stems flex
— roses subtly move
— petals tremble
— leaves orient
— tiny root structures make subtle independent motion

Not aggressive.

Not tentacles.

Not static decoration.

======================================================================
BUTTERFLIES — ALWAYS MOVING
======================================================================

THE BUTTERFLIES AROUND THE BOTANICAL ARM MUST NEVER FREEZE.

Approximately 5–8 depending on framing.

They:

flutter,
circle,
hover,
land briefly,
open and close wings,
lift off,
move through different depth planes.

One may pass close to camera and become soft bokeh.

No synchronized swarm.

======================================================================
LIFE / DEATH EFFECT
======================================================================

When she takes a step near the tree:

small colored flowers / moss / tiny vines may briefly emerge.

They should die VERY QUICKLY.

Growth:

0.3–0.5 seconds.

Then immediate decay:

petals curl,
colors drain,
stems blacken,
leaves shrivel,
growth collapses.

This is a brief visual detail only.

Do not let it delay her disappearance.

======================================================================
FEMALE VOICE
======================================================================

She speaks ONLY:

“This way.”

Voice:

soft,
female,
ancient,
sorrowful,
slightly spectral,
quietly urgent.

Not cheerful.
Not seductive.
Not conversational.
Not demonic.

No second line.

======================================================================
CAMERA LANGUAGE
======================================================================

NO STATIC CAMERA.

NO BASIC SHOT-REVERSE-SHOT.

USE:

— motivated camera arcs
— foreground branch/root parallax
— low angles
— subtle Dutch tilt where appropriate
— cinematic push-ins
— short orbiting movement
— shallow depth of field
— premium macro close-ups
— controlled handheld breathing

EVERY SECOND MUST ADVANCE:

DISCOVERY
→ GUIDE
→ DISAPPEARANCE
→ HERO DECISION
→ CHASE
→ BLINDING THRESHOLD.

======================================================================
0:00–0:02.8 — HERO TURNS / CAMERA REVEALS HER
======================================================================

50mm MEDIUM-CLOSE.

Hero is standing in the established Hollow Heart field.

He is visibly shaken.

Breathing hard.

His true see-through chest cavity is visible.

A deep ancient WOOD CREAK comes from behind / side.

Hero's EYES move first.

Then head.

Then shoulders.

As he turns:

DO NOT HARD CUT.

Camera performs an elegant approximately 120–150 degree ARC around his body.

A twisted foreground root / branch crosses frame to create strong parallax.

The REAL ENVIRONMENT must visibly shift through his empty chest cavity during this move.

As camera completes the arc:

THE COLOSSAL TRAUMA TREE is revealed.

Inside its crimson-lit entrance:

THE FEMALE GUIDE.

Small.

Still.

Watching him.

Hero freezes.

CUT.

======================================================================
0:02.8–0:04.7 — LOW-ANGLE FEMALE REVEAL
======================================================================

28–35mm LOW THREE-QUARTER ANGLE from close to the tree roots.

The guide stands RIGHT AT THE THRESHOLD.

NOT ten feet away.

NOT in the field.

RIGHT at the base / doorway.

Crimson light behind her.

Real tree interior.

Deep bokeh.

Camera drifts slightly laterally.

Her botanical arm is moving.

Butterflies flutter naturally around it.

Both arms clearly present.

One small cluster of strange colored flowers briefly rises near one foot.

Almost immediately begins dying.

She looks toward hero.

CUT.

======================================================================
0:04.7–0:06.6 — FACE / “THIS WAY”
======================================================================

85–100mm PREMIUM CLOSE PORTRAIT.

Slow tiny orbit.

Background is THE REAL crimson tree interior in bokeh.

No solid red backdrop.

Her crescent surface shows:

cracks,
weathering,
mineral texture,
fine grime.

Human eye locks onto hero.

One butterfly crosses deeper behind her.

A tiny vine near shoulder curls slightly.

She whispers:

“This way.”

Nothing else.

She immediately begins turning toward the interior AS the line finishes.

DO NOT HOLD HER AFTER THE DIALOGUE.

======================================================================
0:06.6–0:08.2 — SHE TURNS AWAY
======================================================================

50mm THREE-QUARTER BODY SHOT.

Camera moves with her.

She turns physically toward the deep crimson passage.

BOTH ARMS remain anatomically correct.

Botanical arm swings naturally.

Vines react to motion.

Butterflies react:

two follow the arm,
one rises above shoulder,
one flies into passage ahead of her.

Dress and braid respond to the inward draft.

She takes her first step into the tree.

Small colored plants bloom where her foot leaves the threshold—

then immediately blacken and collapse.

Do not linger.

======================================================================
0:08.2–0:09.8 — SHE DISAPPEARS
======================================================================

35mm SHOT FROM OUTSIDE THE ENTRANCE.

Camera performs a subtle forward creep.

The guide walks rapidly enough to CLEAR THE THRESHOLD.

Not running.

Purposeful.

She moves deeper between the dark organic interior structures.

Crimson light partially silhouettes her.

Then:

her body passes behind an internal organic curve / darkness.

She disappears.

THE LAST THING VISIBLE:

perhaps one butterfly following her deeper.

BY 0:09.8:

THE FEMALE GUIDE IS COMPLETELY GONE.

SHE WILL NEVER APPEAR AGAIN DURING THIS GENERATION.

CUT.

======================================================================
0:09.8–0:11.8 — HERO REALIZES SHE LEFT
======================================================================

70–85mm CLOSE ON HERO.

Camera subtly pushes inward.

Hero stares at the NOW-EMPTY doorway.

His expression:

Wait—

where did she go?

He instinctively looks briefly over one shoulder toward the nightmare field he just escaped from.

Still worried about what is behind him.

He hears something distant / unsettling.

His eyes snap back to the empty crimson entrance.

One anxious breath.

He takes one uncertain step.

Almost stumbles on a root.

Catches himself.

This should feel very human.

He looks into the doorway like:

“Seriously?”

Then commits.

======================================================================
0:11.8–0:15.5 — HE GOES AFTER HER
======================================================================

24–28mm DYNAMIC SIDE / REAR TRACKING SHOT.

Hero begins moving toward tree.

Starts fast walking.

Transitions into an urgent run.

Not heroic.

Not elegant.

He is scared and trying to catch whoever just disappeared.

Camera tracks beside him with strong foreground root parallax.

His hair moves.

Clothing reacts naturally.

Mud compresses.

Small puddle splash.

During one moment:

he GLANCES BACK over his shoulder while still moving.

He is still afraid of what happened behind him.

He almost clips / stumbles over an exposed root because he looked back.

Recovers.

Keeps moving.

NO RANDOM FABRIC ON EXPOSED ARM.

HOLLOW HEART REMAINS COMPLETELY SEE-THROUGH THROUGHOUT MOTION.

======================================================================
0:15.5–0:17.6 — EMPTY DOORWAY / SHE IS NOT THERE
======================================================================

35mm LOW TRACKING FRONT / THREE-QUARTER.

Hero closes in on the entrance.

IMPORTANT:

THE DOORWAY IS EMPTY.

NO FEMALE GUIDE.

NO SILHOUETTE.

NO WOMAN WAITING.

NO FACE.

NO BODY.

Only:

deep crimson interior,
dark organic passage,
subtle red particulate,
perhaps ONE distant butterfly disappearing around a bend.

Hero slows abruptly.

His expression:

“She went in there.”

He looks inside.

Crimson light begins becoming noticeably stronger.

======================================================================
0:17.6–0:18.7 — LIGHT INTENSIFIES
======================================================================

50mm CLOSE MOVING SHOT.

Hero steps closer to threshold.

The deep crimson glow begins blooming toward a HOT CRIMSON-WHITE center deeper inside.

Not instantly pure white.

Progression:

dark red
→ deep crimson
→ saturated red-white
→ overwhelming warm white-crimson brightness.

The light physically increases on hero's face.

He squints.

Turns face slightly away.

Raises one hand instinctively.

======================================================================
0:18.7–0:20.0 — SHIELD EYES / CUT
======================================================================

35–50mm DYNAMIC THREE-QUARTER.

Hero reaches threshold.

The light rapidly becomes overwhelming.

He raises forearm / hand across his eyes.

He physically recoils half a step from intensity.

Then forces himself forward.

Camera moves with him.

His silhouette begins becoming overwhelmed by crimson-white bloom.

IMPORTANT:

DO NOT SHOW HIM FULLY WALKING THROUGH THE TREE.

DO NOT REVEAL WHAT IS ON THE OTHER SIDE.

DO NOT SHOW NEXT BIOME.

He takes the FIRST committed step into the blinding threshold—

WHITE-CRIMSON BLOOM FILLS FRAME.

CUT IMMEDIATELY.
